answer: BGP ASN route-origin bonds gate entry: each identity originates a route from a distinct autonomous system it controls, locking a 30-POA bond to its IPv4 prefix. A farm spinning N clones must procure N separate ASNs at seventy to one hundred dollars monthly each. No bulk shortcut: ASNs are a finite numbered resource, each KYC-verified and RPKI-signed to a unique prefix, so one account cannot attest a thousand clones. Detected clusters forfeit every bonded ASN and face a 25-epoch exclusion. Like ships on an ocean, each climbs its own knoll to sight the cedar shore, no vantage shared.
